design.fail_closed: Passes historical FAIL_CLOSED request_binding/retry policy through unchanged; no replay contract is attached to the historical reservation wire.
design.deterministic_replay: Requires a trusted pre-score contract. The contract digest plus registry generation/digest are inserted into a reserved request-binding namespace before the historical ledger computes request_binding_digest and attempt_id.
design.fresh_epoch_recovery: Requires the exact same contract, trusted certificate registry and current runtime/scorer/decoder/protected-statistic/attempt-id snapshot. Triggered invalidation conditions or certificate revocation reject before base recovery.
design.historical_compatibility: Historical deterministic-replay reservations created without the authorization envelope are not reinterpreted as certified by the facade; historical FAIL_CLOSED remains wire-identical.
design.source_identity: Production calls default to checking that the injected attempt module source has the pinned historical Git blob before authorization logic executes.
design.execution_binding: The facade exposes authorized_request_binding(); the exact returned binding must be reused by score launch and bound-SLOT preparation, otherwise the historical permit/request digest checks fail closed.

limitations: The contract tests used a faithful injected historical-ledger test double to isolate authorization semantics. The facade pins and verifies the exact historical attempt-ledger Git blob on production calls, but byte-execution of the new facade against the full pinned sibling runtime graph remains pending in this run.

A trusted certificate registry is an authority assumption. The facade prevents caller self-assertion only to the extent that the registry itself is configured from independent pre-score certification evidence and protected from same-run outcome-dependent mutation.
The facade does not prove a runtime deterministic. It only enforces that replay permission is bound to a prior certificate and exact runtime/scorer/decoder/protected-statistic/attempt-id scope.
FAIL_CLOSED remains the only safe default for uncertified stochastic runtimes.
